posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
This is a major undertaking, from all sides.

The goal is to make Tactics a much better, and much more marketable entity.

If you've ever seen the first edition of SotM, you can see the flaws in that game.  The Enhanced edition took a great little game and turned it into something much better, and much more marketable.  They (and we playtesters) are trying to do for Tactics what the Enhanced edition did for SotM.

They want the game to work.  They want it to do well enough to fund its sequels.  They don't want it to die with a really nice pre-order for the fans of the first game.

That was where it was heading. (from my understanding)

This is going to take time, and they want to make the Broken City game as much as we want it, but it isn't the right place to start this work.

I am really sad that Expatriette, Hippocalypse, Mr. Fixer and Pinion aren't going to be coming out really soon, but I (with the benefit of working on it as a playtester) see why it needs to happen.

I can tell you that this game isn't going to be that different from Flame of Freedom, not anymore than the enhanced was that different from the first edition of SotM.  But it is going to be better, and hopefully have the kind of staying power that will let us get a lot further into the game than we would have without this process.
